verdict.rationale: Grounding a voice agent on user documents is a fair question for an agent-building framework, but the evidence shows no built-in knowledge base or RAG feature in Pipecat. The context-hub is a local index of Pipecat's own docs and examples for coding agents, not a way to ground your bot on your content. Flows functions that call external systems are only developer building blocks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content
